title: Seeing Basie in Pasadena, and the band's care for him
summary: She saw Basie from across the stage in Pasadena and he sent word to her. Dance relays Bobby Plater's account that the band, sober and on the ball, carried the ailing Basie up theatre stairs on a European tour.
